name: io.github.wyre-technology/afkbot-mcp
title: AFKBot PTO
description: MCP server for AFKBot PTO management — file time-off requests from any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Azure AD (Entra ID) tenant ID for the app registration

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: App registration client ID used to authenticate to AFKBot

environmentVariables.name: AFKBOT_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: AFKBot API base URL — override only for non-production

environmentVariables.name: AFKBOT_APP_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: AFKBot Easy Auth client ID — defaults to production
